Add POWL as a high-confidence medium-voltage switchgear and custom power-control candidate tied to data-center, utility and industrial electrical distribution demand.

node: Grid interconnection, transmission, substations, and transformers
summary: Expanded the universe toward second-order grid chokepoint beneficiaries rather than generic generation owners. The strongest underappreciated mappings in this pass are utility hardware, medium-voltage switchgear and power-control systems, specialty electrical construction labor, GOES/electrical steel inputs, and transformer/substation condition-monitoring systems. These names are not recommendations; they are research candidates for validating backlog quality, book-to-bill, pricing, qualified-supplier status, and whether growth is tied to durable grid/data-center/transmission capex rather than one-off projects.
